title.text: Two cards with the same balance

runs.text: Read an initial balance and create two canteen cards with that balance. Charge 5 pesos to the first and show both balances, separated by a space. If the first one does not have enough, nothing is charged.
from the previous lesson, with its private balance.

hints.text: How many cards have to exist at the end? How many times do you have to create one?
: assigning does not create a new card.
Create each card with its own

runs.text: Make the second card an alias of the first. What does it show now with 20?
Frequent mistake: creating one card and assigning it to both variables, which shows 15 15. Hidden cases: charging exactly the balance, a balance that is not enough and an empty one.
